description:
JStock is open on the Portfolio Management tab. Your task is to record a cash withdrawal from the portfolio (money moving OUT of the brokerage account). 

Record a transaction with the following details:
- Type: Withdrawal (Cash Out)
- Date: March 10, 2024
- Amount: $2,500.00
- Comment: 'Emergency Fund Transfer'

To do this, click the 'Deposit' button (which handles both deposits and withdrawals), select 'Withdrawal' as the type, enter the details, and save.
